### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-email`, touching **4** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx`  _(via renderTemplate (symbol, a top-level function))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via renderTemplate (symbol, a top-level function))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **5** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 15bf186f509521a1be530d19351e0ea63db4a2af` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `f6e536b9e198a3a82afd67bcd2c9614567b2e47c` — the merge of head `eb169bd4581954e934785b082f26488b967f18aa` into base `15bf186f509521a1be530d19351e0ea63db4a2af`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin f6e536b9e198a3a82afd67bcd2c9614567b2e47c && git checkout f6e536b9e198a3a82afd67bcd2c9614567b2e47c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 15bf186f509521a1be530d19351e0ea63db4a2af eb169bd4581954e934785b082f26488b967f18aa && git checkout -B drift-repro 15bf186f509521a1be530d19351e0ea63db4a2af && git merge --no-ff eb169bd4581954e934785b082f26488b967f18aa

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 15bf186f509521a1be530d19351e0ea63db4a2af
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 15bf186f509521a1be530d19351e0ea63db4a2af` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `eb169bd4581954e934785b082f26488b967f18aa`
Local-runs: none

### ① Derived judgments

Inputs read: card #20374 body and all 6 comments; PR #20392 body, its 7-file list and the net diff `c577e666..eb169bd4` (+332/−21); the 35 check-runs on the head. The seat's claim, its ACCEPT and the dev report were read as claims and re-derived from the tree.

- **Public surface unchanged — right.** `packages/plugins/plugin-email/package.json` `exports` addresses only `.` (dist/index.*); the shared tsup entry is `src/index.ts`; `src/index.ts` is not in the diff and still exports `renderTemplate, requireVars, htmlToText` from the engine and nothing else. `renderPlainTextTemplate` is reachable from no entry type, so per the contract-review rule it is shipped bytes, not a published accept set. `IEmailService`, `RenderTemplateInput` and `RenderTemplateResult` in `packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts` are untouched; that contract promises `subject` as "Rendered subject line" and `text` as "Rendered plain-text body" and never promised entities, so the change moves the implementation toward the contract.
- **HTML face byte-identical — right, shown statically.** The head's private `render()` body is the base `renderTemplate` body with one line changed: `escapeHtml(str)` became `encode(str)`, and `renderTemplate` passes `encode = escapeHtml`. Every hole shape (double-brace, triple-brace, formatter) therefore takes the exact base path for `body_html`; the base `isUnescaped` test at line 103 and the switch at line 120 are the same expressions at head lines 144 and 161.
- **Plain-text face semantics match the doc page — right.** With `encode = verbatim`, `isUnescaped ? str : encode(str)` yields `str` for both brace shapes; a formatted hole is encoded after `formatValue`, so formatter output is verbatim; a missing value returns the empty string before encoding on both faces. The changeset's "triple braces mean the same as double there" and the page's "missing placeholder renders as an empty string" and "unknown formatter falls back to the raw value" all hold on the code.
- **Behaviour change on published outputs — right, and no in-repo consumer relied on the encoded form.** `resolveAndRenderTemplate` (email-service.ts:1386-1390) is the one render entry behind `sendTemplate` and `IEmailService.renderTemplate`; the only non-test caller of the engine's `renderTemplate` in the repo is line 1387 (`inbox-channel.ts:182` calls the service method; `expression.zod.ts:469` is an unrelated local function). Consumer sweep: `plugin-auth/auth-manager.ts` five `sendTemplate` sites (1682, 1744, 3366, 3620, 5185) read only `result.status`; `service-messaging/email-channel.ts:338` reads only `status` and `id`; the three transports pass `subject`, `text`, `html` as separate fields (smtp.ts:219-222, resend.ts:51-54, postmark.ts:51-55) and compose no markup; `rowToNormalized` (email-service.ts:392-403) forwards `row.subject` and `row.body_text` as-is, so the queued and stranded delivery paths send the bytes the row holds. Zero readers of `sys_email.body_text` or `subject` outside plugin-email (positive control: the same grep for `body_html` hits the platform-objects field declarations and the dogfood fixture); zero entity spellings or entity decoders outside plugin-email other than three unrelated escapers (the 404 page host in serve.ts, approvals action pages, escape-mdx). Zero tests outside plugin-email assert entity spellings on subject or text (positive control: plugin-email's own `template-engine.test.ts` hits on the HTML face and on `htmlToText` inputs).
- **No plain-text face flows into markup on any path in this repo — right.** Subject: `send()` trims it (email-service.ts:273) and hands it to the transport header and to `sys_email.subject` (Field.text); no HTML composition anywhere. Inbox: `inbox-channel.ts:186-187` stores `rendered.subject` as `title` (Field.text) and `rendered.text` as `body_md` (Field.markdown, written at line 204); no runtime package renders markdown to HTML (grep for marked, markdown-it, remark, micromark over `packages/**` non-test: zero). The inline notify path already wrote unencoded interpolated values into the same column (`notify-node.ts` execute(): `stringifyForTemplate(interpolate(cfg.message))`, then `messaging-service.ts:1100-1101` `str(payload.body)`, then `inbox-channel.ts:204`), and the no-`body_text` fallback already decoded entities via `htmlToText`; so the template path now matches two pre-existing paths and opens no new class here. Console rendering of `body_md` is outside this repo and stays unmeasured, as the PR body says.
- **Derived fallback unchanged — right.** A row with no `body_text` still takes `htmlToText(html)` where `html` is the unchanged HTML face; `decodeEntities` is used only inside `htmlToText`. Pinned by the new "row with NO body_text" case.
- **Doc page `content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx` — every sentence right against the code.** Only the Placeholders intro and the two brace bullets change. "Escaping follows the face: only `bodyHtml` is markup, so only `bodyHtml` HTML-escapes its values" is lines 1386-1390. "`subject` and `bodyText` … render every value verbatim — an ampersand in a link stays an ampersand, so the plain-text part never needs triple braces" is the `verbatim` encoder. The double-brace bullet ("HTML-escaped in `bodyHtml`, verbatim in `subject` and `bodyText`") and the triple-brace bullet ("not escaped even in `bodyHtml`") match `renderTemplate` and `renderPlainTextTemplate`. The unchanged sentences stay true ("missing placeholder renders as an empty string", "unknown formatter falls back to the raw value", "`bodyText` … derived … by stripping tags"). This is the only doc or skill describing template escaping: a grep for escaping and triple braces over `content/docs/**` and `skills/**` hits only this page; `content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/email-service.mdx` says nothing on escaping; the spec `.describe()` strings for `subject`, `bodyHtml`, `bodyText` (email-template.zod.ts:157-167) say nothing on escaping, so the generated reference is not made false. The page is hand-written (not references/ or releases/), and no meta.json change is needed.
- **Test edits — right.** `template-locale-resolution.test.ts`: `expected().when` is an Intl short date plus short time, which carries no escapable character, so `esc()` on the subject was vacuous; dropping it states the new truth and `html` keeps `esc()`. `plain-text-faces.test.ts`: 4 templates × 4 locales × 2 plus 4 controls = 36 cases; every expectation is an independent literal; the harness runs the real `EmailService` over `BUILTIN_AUTH_TEMPLATES` and one authored row nobody hand-braced. `template-engine.test.ts`: 6 new cases including the HTML-face control.
- **PR body and changeset sentences — checked, none false.** Verified: the single non-test engine caller; the inbox channel as the one non-email consumer; base line refs :78, :103, :120; `ENTITIES` and `decodeEntities` used only by `htmlToText`; `auth.invitation` sent via `sendTemplate` at auth-manager.ts:3366; "No test expected entities in a text body"; main moved 6 commits (`c577e666..15bf186f`) with an empty diffstat on plugin-email, the doc page, service-messaging and the spec email contract; on the base the subject went through `escapeHtml`, so the apostrophe entity and ampersand entity claims for subjects hold. The dist byte claims (index.d.ts names it 0 times; the built CJS `renderTemplate` still escapes) follow from the exports and entry graph and were not re-measured here.
- **Two NOT MEASURED gates — answered green by the head's check-runs.** `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` runs in ci.yml job `build-core` (line 2116, inside the job spanning 1960-2161): check-run `Build Core` success. `check:type-check-debt` runs in lint.yml job `typecheck-debt` (line 6296): check-run `Type Check · debt ledger` success; the aggregate `TypeScript Type Check` success.
- **Check-runs on the head:** 35 runs, latest per name all `success` except `Console Pin Gate` and `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`, both `skipped` by design (no pin change, no opt-in). All seven required contexts success. `Check Changeset` success. No governed surface in the file list; 353 changed lines; head repo equals base repo; draft against `main`.
- **Commit and PR-bound text:** the head commit ends with the model-free trailer pair; no model identifier appears in the commit message, PR body, changeset, doc page or diff.
- Nit (no effect on the conclusion): the PR body's third in-place condition reads "the same line of the same render entry, which the claim's file surface already names", where os-dev.md ③ reads "no other claim holds the file". The fact ③ names is established anyway: the dispatch read 0 of 15 open PRs touching plugin-email, and the head's check-run "No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path" is success.

### ② Semver level

- `@objectstack/plugin-email` is a released package (no `private`, `files` ships dist, README.md and CHANGELOG.md, version 17.4.0); `.changeset/20374-plain-text-faces-unescaped.md` declares it `patch` — right: a bug fix in a released package takes `patch`, never none and never `skip-changeset`.
- `Clause-②: no` — right. Accept set: `requireVars`, the loader, the locale ladder and every refusal (`TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND`, `TEMPLATE_INACTIVE`, `MISSING_VARIABLES`) are untouched; nothing formerly refused is accepted and nothing formerly accepted is refused. Public surface: the `exports` map and `src/index.ts` are unchanged and `renderPlainTextTemplate` is unreachable from the entry. No `packages/spec/src/**` path in the diff, so the path arm is not hit; no narrowing arm applies. The PR body carries `Clause-②: no` at line 3, matching the claim; `Check Changeset` is success.
- Changeset prose: states what was wrong, what changes, who sees it and what is unchanged; every sentence verified in ①; nothing is removed or renamed, so no migration text is owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Flag: the subject fixed in place (declared deviation).** Against os-dev.md's four bounded in-place conditions: ① same defect class — a plain-text face rendered through the HTML escaper, the adjacent line of the same render entry: holds. ② mechanical, shape already pinned — the same `renderPlainTextTemplate` call, pinned by three subject literals in `plain-text-faces.test.ts` (built-in control, authored row, render-only): holds. ③ no other claim holds the file — 0 of 15 open PRs touched plugin-email at dispatch and the single-writer-path check-run is success: holds. ④ same gate family, no new verification surface — same vitest family, no new gate: holds. The two debts: the claim's file surface already names `email-service.ts`, so nothing was owed there, and the PR body names the fix with evidence. Disposition holds.
- **Flag: doc page outside the claimed surface (declared CONFLICT).** os-dev.md line 67 requires fixing a published statement the round makes false; the base sentence naming the double-brace hole as HTML-escaped under "Subject and both bodies" became false. The edit is owed, was declared in the report, and the seat's ACCEPT records the revised surface. Every sentence checked in ①. Disposition holds.
- **Flag: out-of-scope note — inbox `body_md` now receives raw authored values (unfiled, in Acceptance notes).** Holds as an acceptance note, not a blocker: the same column already received unencoded values from the inline notify path and from the no-`body_text` fallback (evidence in ①); `RenderTemplateResult.text` is contracted as plain text; this repo has no markdown-to-HTML renderer, so the only open question (whether the console renders raw HTML inside `body_md`) lives in objectui and can be given no repro evidence from here. Prime Directive 10 asks a card to name its evidence; none is measurable on this tree, so leaving it as a note is the right disposition. No measurable regression is introduced on this tree.
- **Flag: two NOT MEASURED gates** — answered by `Build Core` and `Type Check · debt ledger` on the head (①).
- **Flag: CI not awaited at report time** — now fully green on `eb169bd4`.
- `open_questions`: empty — nothing to answer or escalate.
